projections.description: NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 LABOR CATEGORY 27– ORACLE E-BUSINESS SUITE FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONAL SME Location: Braine-l’Alleud, Belgium (on site, or as otherwise coordinated with the FinS System Management Team and confirmed by SSBA) Number of Candidates: One candidate Period of Performance: Required start date and end contract date: ASAP – 31 Dec 2026 Option period 1 Jan 2027 – 31 Dec 2027 – Option period 2: 1 Jan 2028 – 31 Dec 2028 Taskings: Perform ACT FinS Service Lifecycle Management activities as part of the ACT FinS Service Delivery Team, while co-located with the SSBA BA FinS Service Delivery Team. Be responsible for assigned Oracle E-Business Suite business applications and services. Provide first- and second-line support to ACT for assigned business applications by responding to service requests; investigating and resolving incidents and problems; communicating solutions and advice; and proposing changes and improvements based on best business practices. Gather, analyse, configure, design and document new requirements and change requests. Ensure full lifecycle testing of requests for change before presentation to users for user acceptance testing. Contribute actively to relevant projects and service operations across service lines where integration is required. Provide briefings and presentations and perform other duties as required. Conduct work one day per week on site at the NCI Agency location in Braine-l’Alleud, with the remaining effort performed remotely, in coordination with the FinS System Management Team and key users. Use the NCI Agency-provided NPCL laptop for the services. Personal or non-approved devices shall not be used to access NATO systems or data; provisioning, access activation and configuration shall be completed by the NCI Agency before work starts. Coordinate planned leave, absences and changes in availability in advance with the ACT FinS System Management Team. ACT will prioritise assigned work based on operational urgency, financial reporting deadlines, incident severity and available part-time capacity. Submit a monthly activity report by the fifth working day of the following month to the ACT Financial Controller, covering work performed, progress against assigned tasks, issues requiring ACT attention and planned activities for the next reporting period. Travel expenses shall be included in the rate. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 Essential Qualifications 1. A minimum of four years’ current, detailed and relevant knowledge and experience. 2. Basic SQL and SQL*Plus knowledge. 3. Familiarity with configuration-management and version-control procedures and tools. 4. Ability to work under pressure, on own initiative and without constant supervision, to strict deadlines; strong teamwork, communication and documentation skills; and experience supporting a highly available service. 5. English proficiency at SLP 3333 under STANAG 6001. 6. A minimum of four years’ current, detailed and relevant knowledge of and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite Releases 12.1.3 and 12.2.10+, including a basic understanding of the data model. 7. Working knowledge of the Oracle Unified Method and/or Oracle Application Implementation Methodology. 8. Detailed knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and System Administrator responsibilities, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Sub-Ledger Accounting, Purchasing, Fixed Assets, budgetary control, encumbrance and accrual accounting, public-sector accounting, reconciliations, consolidation, revaluation, period-end processes, reporting, bank reconciliation and electronic payment formats. 9. Knowledge of finance approval workflows, internal controls, access responsibilities, security rules, report groups, profile options, flexfields, workflow monitoring and troubleshooting, standard open interfaces and Approval Management Engine configuration. 10. Experience producing functional design documents, reviewing business procedures and setup, recommending improvements, and preparing, running and documenting unit, system and user acceptance tests. 11. Ability to work with System Administrator and Application Developer responsibilities and experience with WebADI. 12. Active NATO Secret security clearance. Desirable Qualifications Recent NATO experience; knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite Purchasing and Procure-to-Pay processes; experience upgrading Release 12.1.3 to 12.2.x; prior support of NATO’s custom EBS travel add-on; and experience with helpdesk ticketing systems such as BMC ITSM. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 Annex B Requirements Matrix Contractor’s technical proposals will be assessed on the qualifications of the both the company and individuals proposed to perform the work. Individuals’ résumés will be measured against each of the criteria specified below in order to ascertain whether the individuals have adequately qualifications to be considered compliant. (HQ SACT reserves the right to conduct technical discussions of nominated candidates). Examples of how detailed knowledge levels were attained are expected. Ultimately Contractor companies shall clearly demonstrate by providing unequivocal reference to where company/key personnel meet the criteria set forth in this solicitation (please include page number, reference to CV or links as applicable). projections.title: 2024/69 Subministrament d'una dotació d'equipament tècnic pel projecte de recerca Gestion partagées et harmonisée de la biodiversité marine transfrontalière (RESMED+)”
projections.description: Subministrament d’una dotació d’equipament tècnic necessari pels objectius de recerca del projecte “Gestion partagées et harmonisée de la biodiversité marine transfrontalière (RESMED+)” de la Universitat de Barcelona, finançat per la Unió Europea en el marc del programa Interreg POCTEFA EFA070/01. El projecte RESMED+ té com a objectiu millorar la qualitat dels ecosistemes i la biodiversitat mitjançant la posada en marxa d'accions de conservació i gestió que incloguin els hàbitats essencials per a les espècies a escala regional i transfronterera entre Espanya i França, amb la participació de tots els gestors i actors del territori. El projecte RESMED+ investigarà el moviment d’espècies d’interès pesquer a través de la xarxa de telemetria acústica creada en el projecte REDMED, estenent l’estudi a nous hàbitats com praderies submarines, llacunes litorals, estuaris, plataforma continental, canons profunds, ports i esculls artificials, amb un seguiment de noves espècies pelàgiques emblemàtiques (taurons, rajades, etc.). Aquesta informació serà essencial per dissenyar mesures de gestió eficaces que integrin normatives espacials i mesures pesqueres a nivell regional transfronterer Subministrament de loggers per a la mesura de terbolesa de l’aigua Obert simplificat Formalització Awardee: INNOVA oceanografía litoral

projections.title: SPACE THEATRE COMPONENT (STC) PROGRAMME SENIOR MANAGEMENT SUPPORT
projections.description: NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C LABOR CATEGORY 53: SPACE THEATRE COMPONENT (STC) PROGRAMME SENIOR MANAGEMENT SUPPORT Location: Ramstein, Germany (On-site) Number of Candidates: One (1) candidate required Period of Performance: Base Period: Award – 31 December 2026 with four potential 12 – month options Option Year 1: 1 January 2027 – 31 December 2027 Option Year 2: 1 January 2028 – 31 December 2028 Option Year 3: 1 January 2029 – 31 December 2029 Option Year 4: 1 January 2030 – 31 December 2030 Tasking 1. Support the ACT Space Branch PMT in the delivery, synchronization, and implementation of the NATO Space Capability Programme (CPP) across all tranches and associated projects. 2. Support Space Theatre Component (STC) in integrating NATO Space capabilities into Space operational planning and execution activities. 3. Coordinate operational requirements and user feedback between STC, SHAPE, ACT, NCIA, NSPA, and national space organizations. 4. Support the development, refinement, and implementation of programme artefacts, including project proposals, implementation plans, programme reviews, risk registers, dashboards, and capability roadmaps. 5. Support operational validation of CPP capabilities and their integration into NATO command-and-control structures. 6. Support the synchronization of Operational Space Support (OSS), Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Domain Coordination (SDC) capabilities and associated dependencies. 7. Assist in the development of operational procedures, playbooks and coordination mechanisms for space- enabled operations including Space capabilities considerations. 8. Support training, exercises and experimentation activities involving space capabilities. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C 9. Contribute to programme governance activities, PMT meetings, Bi -SC coordination mechanisms, and senior leader engagements. 10. Assist with the identification and prioritization of operational capability gaps and associated requirements. 11. Contribute to the assessment of operational impacts and lessons learned related to the employment of space capabilities. 12. Support the identification, analysis and mitigation of programme risks, interdependencies, and critical paths across all space projects. 13. Support NATO exercises, operational experimentation, evaluations, and lessons learned activities involving Space capabilities. 14. Support experimentation, wargaming, operational demonstrations and exercises, including Arctic Sentry, Cosmic Sentinel, and/or related activities. 15. Contribute to operational acceptance activities, readiness assessments, and transition planning. 16. Support engagement with industry and commercial space actors in support of NATO Commercial Space Strategy implementation. 17. Prepare briefings, analyses, and recommendations for the STC leadership and support the PMT efforts and briefings. 18. Directly supports the STC and will be required to travel to meetings and conferences both within and outside NATO’s boundaries for up to 30 days per year. 19. Performs additional tasks as required by the COTR (in HQ SACT) in close coordination with the STC leadership related to the LABOR category. Essential Qualifications 1. University degree in systems engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or related discipline (five years of experience accepted in lieu). 2. Minimum 5 years’ experience within NATO capability development, programme management, or defence acquisition. 3. Minimum 3 years of operational experience within NATO or national space operations. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C 4. Demonstrated experience in space operations integration within NATO or national commands. 5. Demonstrated knowledge of NATO Space policy, CPP governance and PMT processes. 6. Demonstrate a minimum of 3 years operational knowledge of C2 systems within the last 10 years either as a military officer or as a civilian. 7. Experience supporting multinational programmes and senior -level governance bodies. 8. Programme and Project Management experience in the past 10 years within a complex and dynamic programme environment. 9. Working knowledge of Configuration Management methods and practices. 10. Working knowledge of Capability Architectures 11. Experience with IBM Rational DOORS or equivalent (provide certificates). NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C Annex B Requirements Matrix Contractor’s technical proposals will be assessed on the qualifications of the both the company and individuals proposed to perform the work. Individuals’ résumés will be measured against each of the criteria specified below in order to ascertain whether the individuals have adequately qualifications to be considered compliant. (HQ SACT reserves the right to conduct technical discussions of nominated candidates). Examples of how detailed knowledge levels were attained are expected.
